Roles & Responsibilities
Junior Vessel Operation Executive 
Salary: $3000 - $3500
Working Days: 5 days | 9.00am to 6.00pm
Location: Paya Lebar 
Job Responsibilities
Coordinate with vessels, terminals, suppliers, and service providers on vessel schedules
Manage vessel arrivals, departures, and port formalities, including tug/pilot arrangements and crew-related matters
Submit required documentation to the Port Authority and other relevant regulatory bodies
Arrange and supervise the supply and delivery of ship spares, stores, provisions, and services
Monitor vessel ETAs and track vessel movements while in port
Handle vessel and cargo documentation
Assist with crew operations, documentation, and crew change coordination
Prepare and submit estimated and final port disbursement accounts to owners
Liaise with shipowners and principals regarding agency appointments, SOA updates, and payments
Provide operational support to the immediate supervisor and perform additional duties as assigned
Requirements:
Diploma in Maritime
